title: The Ask scoring run never scores a case that did not run
goal: The scored test set is how a change to Ask is kept or thrown away. When Ask's model is not answering (it did not start, or the runner is down), every case ends at once, yet the test set still scores the run, records it in the history and prints a verdict such as throw it away. A runner reading that could throw away a good change. It should stop and say the model is not answering instead. The same goes for one case the app never received: the case that starts on three clips sometimes scores 0 because of a timing race, which can move the video score by about 17 points.

Output: both cases ran in about 1 s ('asked, quiet after 0.13s'), ask state phase stopped, says 'Ask needs Ollama. See Settings.', steps []. Scored 8.6 and 7.5 (judge read 'the video is unchanged'), total 8.1, printed '==> WORSE: throw it away (against "picture model try: z-image-turbo q8 + vtracer")' and appended run 20261022-162402-ask to queue/evals/ask-eval-history.jsonl. The digest pass removed that history line and the run folder by hand. Code: Scripts/ask-eval/eval.mjs.

Folded in from an-eval-case-that-starts-on-three-clips-runs-whe: Reproduced 2026-10-22 by the ask-works-on-a-mac-that-has-nothing-else-install runner: runs 20261023-001800-ask, 20261023-002716-ask, 20261023-004119-ask and 20261023-010308-ask all printed `total 0 over 1 cases` / `not run: the sample recording never opened`; the walk folder stayed empty (no log.json) and playtest.sh ran out of time at 540 s with the probe idle. The same walk file run by hand (Scripts/playtest.sh <ask-walk.json> --no-build) starts and runs. Cause: engines.mjs prepare() starts the MCP bridge in parallel with the walk; Sources/PhotonzMCP/main.swift launches the probe itself when none is running (PHOTONZ_APP_PATH, launchPatience 25 s). When the build or launch is slow the bridge launches a bare probe first, the walk launch lands on that instance and its --playtest arguments are lost. With --no-build it usually wins the race (4 of 5 runs scored). Fix: start the bridge only after the walk has started (wait for the walk log), or tell the bridge not to launch.
